summary: Narrow steep lane with houses hard against it and nowhere to pull off.
reasons: Narrow lane, no room off lane

best_section.where: flat lower end of the narrow lane, near its start

drivers.seclusion: Dense housing all round; dwellings within 1-13 m beyond 50 m, others 31 m at the start.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane squeezed between houses and bush; no clear shoulder, looks like shared driveway access.
drivers.traffic: Very little through traffic; a dead-end style lane serving homes.
drivers.convention: No parked-vehicle convention beyond residents' own cars.

flags: Low-lying: min 5.2 m, Witton Creek 15 m
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over most of it, shading from the south and east.
